units.text: INT. DOLLHOUSE - CONTINUOUS
outside.
. It is I. May I come in for a moment?
units.name: RANK

units.text: in a fretful whisper.
. Oh, what does he want now?
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Aloud.
Wait a minute!
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Unlocks the door.
Come, that’s kind of you not to pass by our door.
units.name: HELMER

units.text: I thought I heard your voice, and felt as if I should like to look in.
units.name: RANK

units.text: With a swift glance round.
Ah, yes!—these dear familiar rooms. You are very happy and cosy in here, you two.
units.name: RANK

units.text: It seems to me that you looked after yourself pretty well upstairs too.
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Excellently. Why shouldn’t I? Why shouldn’t one enjoy everything in this world?—at any rate as much as one can, and as long as one can. The wine was capital—
units.name: RANK

units.text: Especially the champagne.
units.name: HELMER

units.text: So you noticed that too? It is almost incredible how much I managed to put away!
units.name: RANK

units.text: Torvald drank a great deal of champagne tonight too.
units.name: NORA

units.text: Did he?
units.name: RANK

units.text: Yes, and he is always in such good spirits afterwards.
units.name: NORA

units.text: Well, why should one not enjoy a merry evening after a well-spent day?
units.name: RANK

units.text: Well spent? I am afraid I can’t take credit for that.
units.name: HELMER

units.text: clapping him on the back.
. But I can, you know!
units.name: RANK

units.text: Doctor Rank, you must have been occupied with some scientific investigation today.
units.name: NORA

units.text: Exactly.
units.name: RANK

units.text: Just listen!—little Nora talking about scientific investigations!
units.name: HELMER

units.text: And may I congratulate you on the result?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Indeed you may.
units.name: RANK

units.text: Was it favourable, then?
units.name: NORA

units.text: The best possible, for both doctor and patient—certainty.
units.name: RANK

units.text: quickly and searchingly.
. Certainty?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Absolute certainty. So wasn’t I entitled to make a merry evening of it after that?
units.name: RANK

units.text: Yes, you certainly were, Doctor Rank.
units.name: NORA

units.text: I think so too, so long as you don’t have to pay for it in the morning.
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Oh well, one can’t have anything in this life without paying for it.
units.name: RANK

units.text: Doctor Rank—are you fond of fancy-dress balls?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Yes, if there is a fine lot of pretty costumes.
units.name: RANK

units.text: Tell me—what shall we two wear at the next?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Little featherbrain!—are you thinking of the next already?
units.name: HELMER

units.text: We two? Yes, I can tell you. You shall go as a good fairy—
units.name: RANK

units.text: Yes, but what do you suggest as an appropriate costume for that?
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Let your wife go dressed just as she is in everyday life.
units.name: RANK

units.text: That was really very prettily turned. But can’t you tell us what you will be?
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Yes, my dear friend, I have quite made up my mind about that.
units.name: RANK

units.text: Well?
units.name: HELMER
